current: Four hidden values per lane; Load4(half) uses two half2 source loads, compiled as one64-bit global load inside the ordered expert loop. Row width2560 means three outer passes with256,256,128 live lanes. Explicit F32 fma order per expert is already anchored.
proposal: Evaluate eight hidden values per lane with two independent ordered F32 accumulation vectors, reducing outer passes to256 and64 live lanes. Preserve every per-value expert order, shared expert fma, LDS row bytes and later HC/residual/norm code. Use aligned128-bit load only with valid alignment; retain fallback otherwise.
risks: Eight accumulators/loads can raise register pressure or memory stalls. The existing64-bit access is already vectorized; only a changed dataflow merits a new candidate.
